# Third-party code

Both are loaded as classic scripts, only on the pages that need them.

- **qrcode.js** — qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase. MIT licence.
  https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- **jsqr.min.js** — jsQR 1.4.0 by Cosmo Wolfe. Apache License 2.0.
  https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

jsqr.min.js is minified from the npm package with esbuild; qrcode.js is the original file.
